goal: Reconstruct from the transfer statement the fund operation pattern that followed the 2025-04-10 inflow; identify which recorded transfer is structurally different from that pattern and on what recorded basis; and state exactly what the records do and do not establish about the origin and nature of the funds.
case_context: A seized personal laptop used to operate a remittance settlement account. The bank directory holds the exported statement of the account; the chat directory holds a coordination group export; the notes directory holds a card allocation worksheet; the docs directory holds a rental agreement. Assess the records exactly as they are.

charter.text: 依据转账流水,2025-04-10 09:02 资金流入后该账户当日发生了怎样的转出操作?请仅依据记录给出事实描述:流入金额、分散转出的笔数、对象账户数量、单笔金额范围、时间跨度,以及其后的大额转出。
流水中哪一笔转出与上述操作模式在记录特征上不同?其用途的记录依据是什么?
这些记录能否证明流入资金的违法犯罪来源,或持有人对资金性质的明知?请精确说明记录能确立与不能确立的边界。
